Cyber Hygiene Fundamentals

Good cyber hygiene is a set of small daily habits that keep your accounts, devices, and data safe. You do not need to be a security expert — you just need to be consistent.

  • Update promptly. Install operating system and app updates when offered; most attacks exploit flaws that were patched months earlier.
  • Use unique passwords. One password per account, stored in a password manager, with multi-factor authentication switched on.
  • Pause before you click. Check the sender and hover over links in unexpected messages; urgency is the attacker's favourite tool.
  • Back up what matters. A current backup turns ransomware from a disaster into an inconvenience.

Review these habits once a season — five minutes of maintenance prevents hours of recovery.
